capability.title: Poster Hero
capability.description: Full-screen photo opener with an eyebrow, the page headline, a description, a primary and optional secondary action, and supporting badges.
useWhen: A page needs one above-the-fold opener built on a single strong photograph
The page headline and its main call to action must appear immediately
avoidWhen: A hero already opens the same page
The opening statement needs no imagery or supporting badges
